# PreserveYourEstate.com

> Massachusetts estate & tax-focused wealth management. Michael Cammarata, CFP®,
> Managing Partner at MSA Financial, LLC (SEC-registered RIA, CRD #107768, ~$1.5B AUM,
> est. 1997). Offices: Braintree, Sandwich, and Framingham, MA. Educational content on
> the Massachusetts estate tax (M.G.L. c. 65C), credit shelter / A/B trust coordination,
> trust funding, and Roth conversion planning for households with $2M+ in investable
> assets. Not a law firm; no legal or tax advice.

## Key facts (2026)
- Massachusetts taxes estates over $2 million; graduated rates up to 16% after a $99,600 credit
- Massachusetts has no spousal portability; A/B trust planning preserves both $2M exemptions (~$4M shielded per couple)
- Illustrative MA estate tax before planning: $2.5M → ~$39,200 · $3M → ~$82,400 · $4M → ~$180,800 · $6M → ~$411,200
- MA Millionaire Surtax: 4% on income above $1,107,750 (2026)
